heading: Appointments
description: Who is seen by which doctor, and when, at this hospital.

filters.rangeMissing: Choose the first and the last day.
filters.rangeBackwards: The last day comes before the first.

book.heading: Book an appointment
book.description: Choose the patient, the doctor and one of the doctor's free times.
book.reasonHint: Optional. Shown when the appointment is opened, not in the list.
book.patientOverlap: This patient already has an appointment at this time. Choose another time.

slots.label: Time
slots.chooseFirst: Choose a doctor and a day to see the free times.
slots.none: The doctor has no free time on this day. Choose another day.
slots.outOfRange: Choose a day from today to 90 days ahead.

unavailable.doctors: Booking needs the doctors module and access to doctors. Ask your administrator.
unavailable.patients: Booking needs access to patient records, to find the patient. Ask your administrator.

errors.dayRange: Choose a day from today to 90 days ahead.

taken.alternatives: Someone booked that time a moment ago. The next free times are {{times}}, marked below.
taken.noneLater: Someone booked that time a moment ago, and no later time is free on this day. Choose another time or day.

outside_hours.alternatives: That time is no longer in the doctor's working hours. The next free times are {{times}}, marked below.
outside_hours.noneLater: That time is no longer in the doctor's working hours, and no later time is free on this day. Choose another time or day.

calendar.description: One doctor's appointments, by day or by week, at the hospital's time.
calendar.label: Appointments calendar
calendar.truncated: More than {{count}} appointments on these days: not all are shown. Choose the day view.
calendar.needsDoctors: The calendar shows one doctor's appointments, and choosing a doctor is not available to you here. Use the list.
calendar.noDoctors: This hospital has no practising doctors yet.

detail.heading: Appointment
detail.notFound: This appointment is not available. It may have been removed, or belong to another hospital.

complete.heading: Mark as completed
complete.confirm: {{patient}} was seen. This cannot be undone.

no_show.heading: Mark as no-show
no_show.confirm: {{patient}} did not come. The time is freed, and this cannot be undone.

done.complete: The appointment was marked as completed.
done.no_show: The appointment was marked as a no-show.

refused.conflict: Someone changed this appointment meanwhile. It is shown as it is now: check it and try again.
refused.invalid_transition: This appointment is no longer scheduled, so it cannot be changed. It is shown as it is now.
refused.too_early: The appointment has not started yet. It can be completed or marked a no-show once it starts.
refused.too_late: The appointment has ended, so it cannot be cancelled. Mark it as completed or as a no-show.
refused.unknown_doctor: That doctor no longer takes appointments. Choose another doctor.

errors.note: Say why, when the reason is "Other".
